metadata.role: Sample, antibody and DLA typing metadata
metadata.source_update: 2026-10-06; community-annotated, so PRIDE may revise it, and a rebuild needs this exact file

coverage.target_resolution: peptide: the unmodified amino-acid sequence; each modified form is a separate source row
coverage.identification: PEAKS Studio 11.5 at 1% peptide FDR (decoy-fusion), per the article. The tables also export DeepNovo (de novo) and Homolog (SPIDER) identifications, kept with their type.

search_databases.UniProt9615: UniProt Canis lupus familiaris proteome (taxon 9615) with Biognosys iRT peptides; release not stated
search_databases.MergedCanFams: Merged CanFam3.1 (Ensembl 104), CanFam4 (UCSC), Basenji (Ensembl 104) and Great Dane (Ensembl 104) proteins
search_databases.Basenji: Basenji proteins (Ensembl 104), with Biognosys iRT peptides, per the table name and the article
search_databases.Zoey: Great Dane (Zoey) proteins (Ensembl 104), with Biognosys iRT peptides, per the table name and the article
search_databases.SwissProt9606: SwissProt Homo sapiens (taxon 9606) with Biognosys iRT peptides

coverage.search_fastas: not deposited; protein containment of reported accessions is not verified
coverage.repeated_searches: Each dog tumour's spectra were searched against four databases; one peptide in two of its tables is one observation, not two
coverage.nc_orf_search: not performed: canonical protein databases only

raw_files_not_deposited.note: Rows whose best spectrum comes from a run missing from the deposited raw archive (row counts per table set)

coverage.measurement_limits: PEAKS label-free area and intensity; no copies per cell; no normalization across runs
coverage.missingness: An empty Area/Intensity is missing; peptides absent from a table have no observation
coverage.mhc_typing: Deposit SDRF, which the article's Table 1 matches; HCT 116 lines are monoallelic DLA-88 transductants

operations: keep every reported peptide row, its identification type, score and modifications
store native PEAKS area, intensity and spectrum count without normalization
map each peptide to its PEAKS-reported accessions per search database
